answer: Sybils are cheap only while identity is free, so price the identity itself: Hold all rewards in a 116-POA escrow that vests only after 8 epochs of clean, independently graded work, and forfeit the entire grant - not the vested slice - on any slash inside the window. The sable cliff is fixed at deposit and written into the ledger, so a farm that abandons a batch of aliases walks away with nothing while the ocean of forfeited grants pays honest graders and the raven of vesting is steepest at the start.
